title: Page editor
summary: The one block editor of the SIMAI page: layout and text in one Composition Document, edited by depth. A click on text types, a click beside it chooses the block, Esc goes up and Enter down. One catalogue (Text and Blocks, groups, variants with pictures, search, favourites, recent) serves the + between blocks, / in text and the library; blocks move by the grip with drop lines or Alt+arrows, and a drop beside a block splits it into columns. The parameter panel says where every value comes from (type, theme, variant, block, screen) and sets values per screen; the Data tab binds a block to a host source through the source port. The block builder makes and changes site blocks everywhere; the site template is a separate, explicit edit. Rights and theme come from the host. One undo history; output as JSON, HTML and Markdown.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

screen.description: The screen the page is drawn and its values are set for: desktop (lg), tablet (md), phone (xs).

preferences-key.description: Where favourites and recent blocks are kept through SF.Preferences (sf-editor/<key>); empty keeps them for the session only.

label.description: The accessible name of the page.

document.description: The page: a Composition Document of the profile ui-layout (layout.page, or layout.regions with a banner, main and contentinfo region for a page with a site template). A new one starts editing it; the one the editor sent in change is recognised and kept.

types.description: The host's own block types beside the Framework's; their renderers come in renderers.

renderers.description: The renderers of the host's types: the page is drawn by them as the site draws it.

editor-manifests.description: Composition editor manifests of the host's types, or ones that replace the Framework's: the parameter panel is built from them.

site-blocks.description: The site's own blocks made in the block builder; the newest version of each is offered in the catalogue.

words.description: The words of the host's blocks, by locale.

rights.description: What the person may change, from the host: layout false lets the author write only inside text areas; template false keeps the site template closed; builder false hides the block builder. There is no role switch in the editor.

theme.description: The site's theme: its defaults are a level of where a value comes from, its attributes are put on the drawn page. The editor never changes it; settings_url links to where it is changed.

root.description: layout.page, or layout.regions with banner, main and contentinfo layout.region children.

change.const: Every change dispatches change {document, reason, scope}; nothing is stored by the element. select {ids} says which block is chosen; block-save {manifest, words, changes} hands a new or changed site block to the host.

port.const: connect-port {sources(shape), fields(source), preview(binding, {settings, shape}), saveBlock?(manifest, words)}: the host's data sources (Composition source port) and where site blocks are kept.

select.summary: Choose a block as a press does; with no id the choice is let go.

edit.summary: Put the caret at the end of a text block.

returns.description: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason: unknown | not-text | template | page | layout}

insert.summary: Add a block of a type (and variant) after a block, or where it first fits; the value is the new block's id.

undo.summary: One step back, as ⌘Z: typing and structure are one history.

setParameter.summary: Set a parameter of a block, for a screen when it differs by screen.

returns.description: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason: unknown | template | page | layout}

editTemplate.summary: Start (or end, on false) editing the site template: the header and footer of every page.

buildBlock.summary: Open the block builder: a new site block, one made from a block, or a site block to change everywhere.

returns.description: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason: rights | unknown}

output.summary: The page as JSON, HTML (utility classes) or Markdown of its text areas; the value is the text.

returns.description: {outcome: applied, value: text} or {outcome: refused, reason: unknown}

change.summary: The page changed: {document, reason, scope}. The host saves the document; scope template means the header or footer of every page.

sf-editor-select.summary: This block is chosen: {ids}; empty when none is.

sf-editor-block-save.summary: A site block was saved: {manifest, words, changes}. Keep the manifest in site-blocks.

untrusted_inputs: the Document's text, drawn by the Framework's renderers
link addresses, kept only when safe
the host's source answers, checked by createSourcePort

accessibility.focus: The page is one tab stop; Enter and Esc move by depth, the arrows by siblings; the panels are Framework controls in tab order; changes are said in a status line.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-editor wherever a person builds or writes a page (a Composition Document of the profile ui-layout).
do_not: Do not store the page in the element; listen for change and save the document it carries
Do not give the editor a role switch; set rights from the person's real rights
Do not let a block fetch; give data through connect-port
Do not edit the theme here; link to its settings with theme.settings_url
